intent: Machine-readable design policy. The design gate reads this file. Changing a locked rule requires a tracker decision or ADR because it changes the contract.

raw-color.description: Use a design token. Raw hex, rgb, or hsl values are allowed only inside a :root or [data-theme] token block.

important.description: Do not use !important for layout or color. Motion overrides for reduced motion and static capture may use it.

color-contrast.description: Visible text must meet WCAG AA against its effective background.

focus-visible.description: Every keyboard-focusable control must show a visible focus indicator.

horizontal-overflow.description: A page must not scroll horizontally at any enforced viewport.

element-clipped.description: An element must not extend past the viewport edge.

text-overflow.description: Text must not be hard-clipped without an ellipsis.

viewport-meta.description: A rendered page must declare width=device-width.

spacing-scale.description: Padding, margin, and gap values should use the spacing scale.

type-scale.description: Font sizes should use the type scale.

radius-scale.description: Border radii should use the radius scale.

shadow-token.description: Use a shadow token instead of a raw box-shadow value.

reduced-motion.description: Animations and transitions must respect prefers-reduced-motion.
